chapter_intro.intro_summary: 導言把蒸餾定位為以較小學生配合教師回答或候選機率的一條部署成本路線，要求分別查教師可靠性、訊號對齊與學生改善；本章先用固定數字追踪軟目標、溫度、KL，再看內容、風格、多模態答案位置，任務品質以共同真值衡量，不能以像教師或檔案較小取代完成任務。

claims.statement: 蒸餾讓學生透過教師訊號學習；黑盒常只取得教師文字，白盒可取得輸出分布，類別名稱本身不代表可靠性或真值。
claims.scope: Black/white terminology here classifies accessible text/distribution signals; it is not an exhaustive catalogue of hidden-state distillation or a project ability claim. Intro proposes quality/cost comparison rather than completed cost improvement.

evidence.locator: printed p.2, Introduction first and second paragraphs
evidence.supports: Original explicit black-box teacher-generated text / white-box output distributions or hidden states taxonomy and small student supervision

evidence.locator: printed pp.1-2, Introduction, soft targets versus true targets
evidence.supports: Teacher transfer is distinct from ground truth and smaller-model deployment motivation is a method rationale, not a guarantee

claims.statement: Logits 是未正規化候選分數；softmax沿候選軸得到總和為1的機率；以回答token作SFT目標能用CE提高示範答案機率。文字類索引和soft分布所需輸入不同，不能僅因同是教師訊號便忽略目標形式。
claims.scope: Softmax is per vocabulary slice; CE can mathematically accept class indices or probability targets, so the text's caution concerns available target information/API shape, not a categorical prohibition on using cross entropy for both.

evidence.locator: printed p.2, Eq.(1) and maximum log probability of correct answer
evidence.supports: Scores-to-probabilities and teacher soft/class targets mechanism
Exact candidate-axis normalization and logits/indices/probability target contracts
This project's SFT CE sums over effective class-index answer targets and averages by their count
